source.dataset: GHS-POP R2023A, epoch 2020, 3 arc-second (~100 m), people per pixel, tile R8_C26
source.provider: Schiavina, M., Freire, S., Carioli, A. & MacManus, K. (2023). GHS-POP R2023A - GHS population grid multitemporal (1975-2030). European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC). doi:10.2905/2FF68A52-5B5B-4A22-8F40-C41DA8332CFE. CC BY 4.0.
source.resampling: each GHS-POP pixel split over the 0.0005 deg grid cells it overlaps, by overlap area

encoding: base64 little-endian Uint32, row-major, same grid as panjimCrzGrid.json
grounding_note: Modelled, not counted: GHS-POP distributes census and projected totals (GPWv4 inputs; for India the 2011 census at sub-district level, projected to 2020) to 100 m pixels in proportion to the built-up residential volume mapped from Sentinel-2 and Landsat (GHS-BUILT-V). It follows buildings, so it is far closer to where people live than a uniform spread, but it is not a count. Cross-checked against the Census 2011 total for Panaji (M Corp. + OG) in docs/model-audit/LOG.md (Phase 2).
